articles.title: Navi Mumbai: Rohit Pawar, Jitendra Awhad Among NCP-SP Leaders Detained As Party Protests Over Recent Petrol, Diesel & LPG Price Hike - WATCH
articles.titleEn: Navi Mumbai: Rohit Pawar, Jitendra Awhad Among NCP-SP Leaders Detained As Party Protests Over Recent Petrol, Diesel & LPG Price Hike - WATCH
articles.summary: NCP-SP leader Rohit Pawar and other party leaders were detained by police during a protest in Navi Mumbai against recent hikes in petrol, diesel and LPG prices. The party symbolically lit a stove on the street to highlight inflation and unemployment. Pawar said the agitation aimed to draw attention to the daily struggles faced by common citizens.
